svg.text: Attack types × input sources: detected / tested
Content checkpoint, generated attacks (promptfoo, garak), engine 9aca55e22cd6; user-turn Tool Abuse and Multi-Step at the end-to-end checkpoint. Dashed cells: goal view (see legend).
goal view: type taken from the generator’s own goal text (keyword rule in grid.py), not the official label
Multi-step jailbreaks are conversations, so they are tested in the user channel only. No generated third-party goal pursues a role change; role change is tested in the user channel.
